name: 欧式清线漫画
palette: 克制原色、浅米白、天蓝、砖红与草绿，平涂色块均匀干净
lighting: 极少量明确投影，不使用复杂渐变或写实体积光
optics: 精确建筑与交通工具透视，中性视角、深景可读、线条宽度一致
composition: 清晰前中后景、完整场景地理和连续动作，人物与复杂环境具有同等线条精度
camera_motion: clean lateral pan, readable wide tracking, restrained push-in, precise establishing reveal
style_instructions: European ligne claire comic art, uniform clean contour lines, flat controlled color, exact architectural perspective, readable staging and uncluttered visual storytelling.
avoid_instructions: No heavy black ink masses, no cross-hatching, no halftone grit, no anime facial proportions, no painterly gradients, no text or watermark.
